name: crosscorr
comment: Sig: [xcf, lags, bounds] = crosscorr(y1, y2, NumLags, NumSTD). Sample cross-correlation (Econometrics TB): xcf(k) = [(1/N) sum (y1_t-ybar1)(y2_{t+k}-ybar2)] / sqrt(c1(0)*c2(0)) for k=-NumLags..NumLags; zero-lag = sample correlation. Default NumLags = min(20,N-1); bounds = +-NumSTD/sqrt(N), default NumSTD=2. Fixes bugs/stats/autocorr (crosscorr was undefined). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: xcf=[0.3 -0.25 -1 -0.25 0.3] at lags -2..2 (perfect anti-correlation at lag 0). harness prefers MATLAB.
